text_block_list.text:
Shocked by her defeat in the race and 
struck by the thought that she might lack 
talent after all, Sakura Bakushin O falls 
into a panic.

The Trainer encouraged her, saying she 
would surely win if she built up more 
speed, and recommended entering the sprint 
race, the Aoi Stakes.

Believing those words, Sakura Bakushin O 
was fired up, determined to show even 
greater growth by her next race.
